Area.evidence_source: ['[page/5/Text/7] He feels very ashamed about what he has done and hesitates to seek care', '[page/5/Text/7] The emergency personnel react to this with some irritation', '[page/5/Text/7] He feels very exposed when he realizes he has \'opened up to the wrong persons\'.', '[page/5/Text/7] Anders also reacts with anger and shame when his expressions of inner feelings are met with condemnations from the personnel, and when the conversations are interrupted.', '[page/5/Text/7] He arrives at the ward with an inner feeling of having \'broken down\'', '[page/5/Text/7] A young female nurse speaks to him calmly and validates his reaction by saying: \'One can\'t stand everything.\'', '[page/5/Text/7] Anders describes as important that the personnel take him seriously.', '[page/5/Text/7] Again Anders hesitates, but decides to \'give it a try\', encouraged by the young nurse.', '[page/5/Text/7] He feels relieved when finally talking with the psychiatrist, who validates his feelings.', '[page/5/Text/7] Anders is admitted to the specialized ward for suicidal patients. He arrives at the ward with an inner feeling of having \'broken down\', but immediately feels at ease in the atmosphere which he describes as \'calm\' and \'friendly\'.', '[page/5/Text/7] Regarding the stay in the ward Anders describes as helpful that the other patients have similar problems (alleviates shame), that the atmosphere is warm and supportive among personnel members as well as patients, that there is the opportunity to think through his situation without the ordinary pressures of everyday life and, most important, the conversations with the psychiatrist, with whom he develops a trustful relationship.']
